name: phone-frame
title: Phone frame
description: A modern phone drawn in CSS around your screenshot or live UI, with island, bezel and side buttons, in the house monochrome.
docs: Pass src and alt for a screenshot, or children for live UI. width is the width of the whole device in px or any CSS length (280 by default, never wider than its container), and every size on the device, from the corner radius to the island, is a share of that width in container units, so it scales cleanly from a thumbnail to a life-size 390px. The same units (text-[4.4cqw], p-[5cqw]) are there for the live UI inside it. The screen keeps the 19.5 to 9 shape of a phone and clips its content to the rounded corners. tone is dark (graphite, the default) or light (silver) around a black bezel; notch is island (default) or none. Live UI is padded clear of the island and the home bar (safeArea, on by default) and scrolls inside the screen; turn it off to draw to the edges and use --phone-safe-top and --phone-safe-bottom, which are set on the screen. The body, buttons, island and home bar are hidden from assistive technology, and the screen has the one name: alt for a picture, label (Phone screen) for live UI or a picture without alt. There are no image files. It is a server component.
